text:
jordan: quick q — where's the canonical spot to look at p50/p95/p99 by model+route and TTFT? trying to tune an alert for a regression.

alex: grafana has the routing-level panels, see 'Inference Latency - per route' dashboard. quick link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/route-latency (requires VPN).

maria: also check Console -> Observability -> Routes -> <route> -> Metrics. that view shows TTFT, tokens/sec and a per-model breakdown.

jordan: thanks — do we have a PromQL snippet for p95 p99? want to use in alert manager.

alex: for p95 latency (ms) you can use something like:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(serving_response_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))
```
and same with 0.99 for p99.

sam: for TTFT we expose a separate histogram `first_token_latency_ms_bucket`. example for p95: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(first_token_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))
```
use 5m window for alerts, 1m for dashboards if you want more granularity.

jordan: nice. any guidance on thresholds? our infra SLO is 200ms p95 TTFT for hosted tier but models vary.

maria: start with SLO as soft alert: p95 > 200ms for 10m -> warning. p99 > 500ms -> paged if sustained >15m. always tie to route tag `environment` and `tier` so you don't page on dev.

alex: also consider tokens/sec as covariate — if tokens/sec spikes, latency rise might be expected. query: `sum(rate(tokens_produced_total[1m])) by (route, model)`

jordan: where do we check traces for a single request? need to confirm slow path is KV miss.

sam: Jaeger link: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=inference-runtime — filter by trace tag `route=<route>` and `span=kv_lookup`. We add `kv_miss=true` on miss paths.

ops-bot: FYI: deployed new histogram buckets for `first_token_latency_ms` in last night's rollout — metrics available after 1800 UTC. :white_check_mark:

maria: good call, if you don't see buckets check deployment age. also watch for quantized model variants — they have shorter tails.

jordan: thanks all — I'll prototype alert rule and post a diff. pinging @alex and @maria for review when ready. :thumbsup:
